authority: REVISED_PLAN.md R4-N1 and docs/research_contract.md (calibration and decision policy). The project owner reported on 15 November 2026 that the team accepted this recipe: the B WavLM procedure (R3-N1) applied unchanged to Protocol A, one pre-declared procedure for all four A models. WavLM-A is calibrated by Subhan; AST-A by Usman; LR-A and BiGRU-A by Nouman. No individual approval record exists in the repository. Derived from configs/r3_n1_wavlm_calibration_b.json: the candidate set, bounds, regularisation, selection rule, acceptance rule, threshold rule, bootstrap and reliability settings are equal; only protocol-bound fields differ (inputs, roles, components, panels, outputs). No fit used the calibration or operating role before this file was frozen.
weighting: one row, equal weight, per recording

selection_rule.statistic: mean over held-out speakers of per-speaker log loss
selection_rule.standard_error: sample standard deviation (ddof 1) of the best candidate's per-speaker losses / sqrt(number of speakers)
selection_rule.choice: simplest candidate (identity, temperature, affine) whose mean is at most best mean + standard error
selection_rule.failed_candidates: excluded and reported; identity if every non-identity candidate fails

acceptance_rule.applies_to: the mapping selected by selection_rule; identity is rejected by definition
conditions: valid fit: solver success, finite objective, parameters strictly inside their bounds (not within bound_tolerance), calibrated scores finite and in [0,1]
operating log loss of calibrated scores strictly lower than raw
operating Brier score of calibrated scores not higher than raw

threshold_rule.plateau_report: number of distinct score-induced partitions that reach the maximum macro F1, and the score interval they span, reported beside the threshold

reliability.definition: equal width on [0,1], last bin closed, empty bins omitted

panels.note: genuine against each generator; informational only. Protocol A has no unseen generator and no duration-matched subset.

restrictions: no test data (the A test partition stays sealed)
no changes to the source bundle, exports or locks
no change to any file hashed in locks/B_lock_gr3.json
operating role opened once, after the mapping is frozen
no FPR constraint, prevalence correction or abstention (needs a recorded pre-result amendment)
